name: paged
description: A full page of 50 computers followed by a short page of one. The REST collection has no cursor and no total, so the walk is driven purely by the offset and by the size of the page that came back: a full page means keep going, a short page means stop. This asserts the second call carries start=50 rather than restarting at zero, that a third call is never made after the short page, and that both pages are parsed into assets. PAGE_SIZE is a constant in the script, so 50 rows is the only way to reach a second page at all.
